title: Long registry tool calls return a job the agent polls (no 502 through the CLI container proxy)
user_story: As the owner I want an agent such as Codex to run a long experiment through the registry without the call failing with HTTP 502 while the run goes on (live run 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A1).

requirements.description: phdlab_tools_call waits at most wait_s (default 45 s, below the CLI clients' 60 s MCP tool timeout; maximum 300 s), then returns the running job with a hint instead of holding the request.
phdlab_tools_job returns the status, observations and result of a job, waiting up to wait_s, and cancels it with action 'cancel'. Every registry client (CLI agents, Hermes, ChatGPT) sees it.
Only the principal that started a job can read or cancel it; another client's or a malformed job id answers not_found, so ids cannot be probed or used as paths.

nonfunctional: Fast calls keep their one-step answer (no hint, same fields)
A still-running call is not an MCP error; a terminal failure still is
outputs: {job, tool, status, result, error[, observations, hint]}
preconditions: A registry grant for the client (agent profile or client profile)
postconditions: No registry call holds an HTTP request longer than its bounded wait
acceptance_criteria: Existing bridge, CLI-agent, ChatGPT and Hermes suites pass with the new tool listed

scenarios.expected: A 2.5 s tool with wait_s 0.3 returns running plus a hint; phdlab_tools_job returns its result
A fast tool still answers in one step, without a hint
The owner cancels a 30 s tool and it ends as cancelled
Negative wait means no wait; huge wait is capped at 300 s; the default stays below 60 s
Another client cannot read or cancel the job; unknown ids are not_found
The job tool is in the bridge, Hermes and ChatGPT tool lists

recovery: Fix at the bridge; never lengthen the HTTP hold or drop the ownership check. TASK-TOOL-JOBS-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real subprocess registry tools in a disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR (tests/_env.py), the real bridge with a private Runtime; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/tool-jobs-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 7 tests on 0e52f6e, 6 failing (the fast-call compatibility check passes on both). GREEN: 7/7.
